theorems.statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (E : Set (Euclid (n + 1))) (C : ℝ), 1 ≤ n → MeasurableSet E → (∀ φ : Euclid (n + 1) → Euclid (n + 1), ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) φ → HasCompactSupport φ → (∀ y, ‖φ y‖ ≤ 1) → ∫ y in E, LinearMap.trace ℝ (Euclid (n + 1)) (fderiv ℝ φ y : Euclid (n + 1) →ₗ[ℝ] Euclid (n + 1)) ≤ C) → ∃ (B : Set (Euclid (n + 1))) (ν : Euclid (n + 1) → Euclid (n + 1)), MeasurableSet B ∧ CountablyRectifiable n B ∧ μHE[n] B ≠ ∞ ∧ Measurable ν ∧ (∀ y ∈ B, ‖ν y‖ = 1) ∧ (∀ᵐ y ∂(μHE[n].restrict B), HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n B y (Submodule.span ℝ {ν y})ᗮ) ∧ (∀ φ : Euclid (n + 1) → Euclid (n + 1), ContDiff ℝ 1 φ → HasCompactSupport φ → ∫ y in E, LinearMap.trace ℝ (Euclid (n + 1)) (fderiv ℝ φ y : Euclid (n + 1) →ₗ[ℝ] Euclid (n + 1)) = -∫ y in B, inner ℝ (φ y) (ν y) ∂μHE[n]) ∧ ∀ᵐ y ∂(μHE[n].restrict B), ∀ ρ : ℝ, Tendsto (fun r : ℝ => volume (symmDiff ((fun w => y + r • w) ⁻¹' E) {w | 0 < inner ℝ w (ν y)} ∩ ball (0 : Euclid (n + 1)) ρ)) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 0)
